Need not over-penalize if conjunction enumerates attributes. Need identify genuinely multiple independently implementable features.

Let's go through all.

This is one feature: search/discover music using method content identification/fingerprinting. "or" not combining independent features? Using fingerprinting is alternatives same feature. No violation.

ZO-002: based on profile. Single.

Search/discover music or ringback tones similar to given music video. Could be one feature with result types music or ringback tones. "music or ringback tones" maybe two different result types but one search/discover capability. Atomic? likely no violation? Need evaluate. "search and discover" maybe same. Could be viewed one feature content similarity search for media. The noun phrase "music or ringback tones" attributes of one search. No Violation likely.

This combines uploading tagged videos and have tags available for further processing steps. Are these two features? Upload tagged videos is feature; having tags available for processing could be consequence/system quality. Atomic? Maybe "upload tagged videos" and "tags available" are tightly coupled one workflow, not independently implementable? Could be one feature: upload with tag extraction/storage. Do we flag? Need decide. Operational: two or more independently implementable/testable/prioritizable features. "upload tagged videos" and "have tags available..." Maybe not independent features? Could be one user story combining upload and tag availability, but tag availability is outcome. I lean No Violation, but need consider if "have tags available" is another capability. Hmm.

Single feature. No violation.

They are closely paired: identify then info. But operational says two or more independently implementable/testable/prioritizable features. Identify persons and receive info are probably independently implementable? You can identify persons without info; or info display separately. Might be violation.
